flags.description: Mondelez continued operating three factories in Russia after the 2022 invasion of Ukraine, reporting $1.417 billion in Russian revenue and paying over $62 million in profit taxes to the Russian government in 2024; Ukraine's anti-corruption agency designated it an 'International Sponsor of War' in 2023, and Buckingham Palace revoked its Cadbury brand's royal warrant in December 2024 over the continued operations.
